usedFor: Amazon Seller Central starts the work with “New Refund”, and Google Drive stores or shares the files that follow.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new order can copy a file into a chosen folder under a new name.

watchOut: “New Order Created” in Amazon Seller Central is polling, so Google Drive actions run after a scheduled check, not instantly.
